---
title: "Notation"
description: "Symbols shared by the vignettes, grouped by role."
date: last-modified
date-format: "D MMM YYYY"
---

A symbol absent from these tables is defined in the vignette that uses
it, with one meaning there. An article embeds only the groups it uses.
$\boldsymbol{\theta}$ is not a relative-abundance symbol: it is the
parameter of interest in a profile likelihood. Other methods may still
write a per-cell mean as $S_j\boldsymbol{\theta}_{\cdot j}$; that is
their split, quoted when a method is reviewed.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

options(tinytable_html_mathjax = TRUE)

# Each table chunk carries two tags. Quarto's notebook embed finds a
# cell by its tag, and a one-element tag is written into the embed
# notebook as a string, which the lookup cannot search. The second
# tag, "embed", keeps the list an array. Do not drop it.

notation_table <- function(symbol, meaning, group, fill, caption, notes = NULL) {
  stopifnot(length(symbol) == length(meaning), length(symbol) == length(group))
  df_rows <- data.frame(Symbol = symbol, Meaning = meaning)
  starts <- which(!duplicated(group))
  group_spec <- stats::setNames(as.list(starts), group[starts])
  n_before <- vapply(seq_along(group), function(k) sum(starts <= k), 1L)
  final_row <- seq_along(group) + n_before
  note_list <- NULL
  if (!is.null(notes)) {
    note_list <- lapply(notes, function(note) {
      list(i = final_row[[note$row]], j = 1L, text = note$text)
    })
    names(note_list) <- letters[seq_along(note_list)]
  }
  tab <- tinytable::tt(
    df_rows,
    notes = note_list,
    width = 1,
    caption = caption
  )
  tab <- tinytable::group_tt(tab, i = group_spec)
  header_rows <- starts + seq_along(starts) - 1L
  tab <- tinytable::style_tt(
    tab,
    i = header_rows,
    background = fill$header,
    bold = TRUE
  )
  blocks <- unique(group)
  for (block in blocks) {
    rows <- which(group == block)
    tab <- tinytable::style_tt(
      tab,
      i = final_row[rows],
      background = fill$data
    )
  }
  tab
}
```

## Indices {#sec-notation-indices}

```{r}
#| label: notation-indices
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-indices, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$g = 1, \\ldots, G$",
    "$j = 1, \\ldots, J$; $\\ell$",
    "$i = 1, \\ldots, N$",
    "$r = 1, \\ldots, R$",
    "$c$; $C_j$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    "Gene.",
    "Cell type, and a second cell type.",
    paste0(
      "Bulk sample. The index is dropped inside a derivation and ",
      "restored in the model statements."
    ),
    "Reference donor (replicate).",
    "Cell, and the number of reference cells of type $j$."
  ),
  group = rep("Indices", 5L),
  fill = list(header = "#d5dee6", data = "#eef2f5"),
  caption = "Indices. The scalar $R$ is the number of reference donors."
)

```

## Cellular ratios {#sec-notation-ratios}

```{r}
#| label: notation-ratios
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-ratios, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$m_{ji}$, $n_i = \\sum_j m_{ji}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{p}_{\\cdot i} \\in \\Delta^{J-1}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\rho}_i \\in \\mathbb{R}^{J-1}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{q}_{\\cdot i}$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    "Cells of type $j$ in bulk sample $i$, and their total.",
    "Cell fractions, $p_{ji} = m_{ji} / n_i$.",
    paste0(
      "Isometric log-ratio coordinates of $\\boldsymbol{p}_{\\cdot i}$, ",
      "$\\boldsymbol{p}_{\\cdot i} = \\operatorname{softmax}",
      "(\\mathbf{V}\\boldsymbol{\\rho}_i)$ with a Helmert basis $\\mathbf{V}$."
    ),
    paste0(
      "Transcript fractions, ",
      "$q_{ji} = p_{ji} S_j / \\sum_\\ell p_{\\ell i} S_\\ell$."
    )
  ),
  group = c(
    "Cell fractions", "Cell fractions", "Cell fractions",
    "Transcript content"
  ),
  fill = list(header = "#d3e4d8", data = "#e7f0ea"),
  notes = list(
    list(
      row = 3L,
      text = paste0(
        "An isometric log-ratio coordinate of the cell fractions. ",
        "Not a correlation."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 4L,
      text = paste0(
        "Content weight used when a method normalises by transcriptome ",
        "size. Not the cell-fraction estimand, which remains ",
        "$\\boldsymbol{p}$. Dividing counts by library size is not an ",
        "observation model: genes that share a divisor become correlated."
      )
    )
  ),
  caption = "Cell fractions and transcript fractions."
)

```

## Reference means {#sec-notation-means}

```{r}
#| label: notation-means
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-means, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$\\boldsymbol{x}_{\\cdot j,i}$",
    "$x_{gc}$, $\\boldsymbol{x}_{\\cdot c}$",
    paste0(
      "$\\tilde{\\boldsymbol{\\mu}}_{\\cdot j} = ",
      "C_j^{-1} \\sum_{c \\in j} \\boldsymbol{x}_{\\cdot c}$"
    ),
    "$S_j = \\mathbf{1}^{\\top} \\tilde{\\boldsymbol{\\mu}}_{\\cdot j}$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    "Purified profile of type $j$ in sample $i$.",
    paste0(
      "Raw UMI count of gene $g$ in reference cell $c$, and that ",
      "cell's count vector."
    ),
    paste0(
      "Per-cell mean of the raw UMI counts of the $C_j$ reference ",
      "cells of type $j$."
    ),
    "Mean transcriptome size of a type-$j$ cell."
  ),
  group = rep("Reference means", 4L),
  fill = list(header = "#d4e0f0", data = "#e8eef6"),
  notes = list(
    list(
      row = 3L,
      text = paste0(
        "A tilde marks a quantity rescaled to a reference unit: per ",
        "cell, or relative to the reference protocol. This mean is a ",
        "mean of raw counts. It is not a library-size proportion."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 4L,
      text = paste0(
        "$S_j$ summarises the raw-count mean. It is not a divisor ",
        "applied to the counts. $\\boldsymbol{\\theta}$ is not used ",
        "for this split."
      )
    )
  ),
  caption = "Purified profiles and per-cell means of raw counts."
)

```

## Biological variability {#sec-notation-biological}

```{r}
#| label: notation-biological
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-biological, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\mu}_{\\cdot j}$, $\\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\Omega}_j = \\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j^{-1}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_{W,j}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{V}_j$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{R}_j$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\Delta}_j = \\operatorname{diag}(\\boldsymbol{V}_j)$",
    "$\\lambda$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_{B,j}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\Gamma}_g$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{S}_W(\\boldsymbol{v}) = \\sum_j v_j \\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_{W,j}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{S}_B(\\boldsymbol{v}) = \\sum_j v_j^2 \\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_{B,j}$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    paste0(
      "Mean and $G \\times G$ gene–gene covariance of a type-$j$ ",
      "profile."
    ),
    "Precision matrix of type $j$.",
    paste0(
      "Within-donor cell-to-cell covariance of type $j$ (one ",
      "single-cell sample)."
    ),
    paste0(
      "Empirical covariance of type $j$, from its reference profiles ",
      "or cells."
    ),
    paste0(
      "Empirical correlation matrix of type $j$. Bold: the scalar ",
      "$R$ is the number of donors."
    ),
    "Diagonal matrix of the empirical variances of type $j$.",
    "Penalty of a regularised covariance or precision estimator.",
    "Between-donor covariance of type $j$ (needs $R \\ge 2$ donors).",
    "$J \\times J$ covariance across cell types for gene $g$.",
    "Linear covariance mixture with weights $\\boldsymbol{v}$.",
    "Quadratic covariance mixture with weights $\\boldsymbol{v}$."
  ),
  group = c(
    rep("Within one reference", 7L),
    rep("Across donors or types", 4L)
  ),
  fill = list(header = "#e6ddd0", data = "#f3eee6"),
  notes = list(
    list(
      row = 1L,
      text = paste0(
        "$\\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j$ couples genes within one cell ",
        "type."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 7L,
      text = paste0(
        "A penalty. The size-free expression of a cell is ",
        "$\\boldsymbol{\\lambda}_{\\cdot c}$, in the technical-scale table."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 9L,
      text = paste0(
        "$\\boldsymbol{\\Gamma}_g$ couples cell types within one ",
        "gene. The opposite orientation from $\\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j$."
      )
    )
  ),
  caption = "Gene–gene covariance within a type, and variation across donors or types."
)

```

## Technical scales {#sec-notation-technical}

```{r}
#| label: notation-technical
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-technical, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$s_c$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{\\lambda}_{\\cdot c}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{z}_{\\cdot c}$",
    "$a_i$",
    "$c_i = a_i n_i$, $\\phi_i = a_i^2 n_i$",
    "$b_g$",
    "$\\tilde{b}_g = b_g^{\\mathrm{bulk}} / b_g^{\\mathrm{ref}}$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{D}_i$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    "Size factor of reference cell $c$.",
    "Size-free expression of cell $c$.",
    paste0(
      "Latent log-expression of cell $c$ in the Poisson log-normal ",
      "model."
    ),
    "Sample-wide scale between the reference and the bulk library.",
    "Mean scale and variance scale of the single-cell model.",
    "Capture efficiency of gene $g$ in one protocol.",
    paste0(
      "Gene-wise platform ratio. ",
      "$\\tilde{\\boldsymbol{B}} = ",
      "\\operatorname{diag}(\\tilde{\\boldsymbol{b}})$."
    ),
    "Diagonal, heteroscedastic bulk measurement noise."
  ),
  group = rep("Technical scales", 8L),
  fill = list(header = "#eadfd4", data = "#f6eee8"),
  notes = list(
    list(
      row = 7L,
      text = paste0(
        "A tilde: relative to the reference protocol, not per cell."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 8L,
      text = paste0(
        "Measurement noise. Not the deviance $\\mathcal{D}_g$ of a ",
        "count model."
      )
    )
  ),
  caption = "Size factors, capture efficiencies, and measurement noise."
)

```

## Bulk observation {#sec-notation-bulk}

```{r}
#| label: notation-bulk
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-bulk, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$y_{gi}$, $\\boldsymbol{y}_{\\cdot i}$",
    "$\\tilde{\\boldsymbol{y}}_{\\cdot i} = \\boldsymbol{y}_{\\cdot i} / n_i$",
    "$\\boldsymbol{T}_{ji} = \\sum_{c=1}^{m_{ji}} \\boldsymbol{X}_{jic}$",
    "$\\sum_j m_j \\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j$",
    "$\\sum_j p_j^2 \\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    "Bulk expression on a linear scale.",
    "Bulk expression per cell.",
    "Total expression contributed by type $j$ to sample $i$.",
    paste0(
      "Covariance when counts are fixed and cells of a type are ",
      "independent."
    ),
    paste0(
      "Covariance when each type contributes one population profile, ",
      "as in a FACS or cytometry reference."
    )
  ),
  group = c(
    "Observation", "Observation", "Observation",
    "Single-cell signatures",
    "Purified profiles"
  ),
  fill = list(header = "#dddbea", data = "#eceaf4"),
  notes = list(
    list(
      row = 2L,
      text = paste0(
        "Per cell, by the number of cells. Not a division of each ",
        "gene by the library total: that division induces a spurious ",
        "correlation between genes."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 4L,
      text = paste0(
        "Single-cell signature paradigm: the reference is the cells."
      )
    ),
    list(
      row = 5L,
      text = paste0(
        "Purified-profile paradigm: one profile per type. The ",
        "likelihood in the package fits this covariance. It is not a ",
        "preferred reference over the single-cell signatures."
      )
    )
  ),
  caption = "The bulk profile and the two reference paradigms. Neither is a gold-standard reference."
)

```

```{r}

  symbol = c(
    "$\\psi_g$",
    "$\\mathcal{D}_g$",

  ),
  meaning = c(
    "Negative binomial dispersion of gene $g$.",

      "Detection rate of gene $g$ in type $j$: the fraction of cells ",

```

## Overlap {#sec-notation-overlap}

```{r}
#| label: notation-overlap
#| echo: false
#| tags: [notation-overlap, embed]
notation_table(
  symbol = c(
    "$\\varpi_{\\ell \\mid j}$, $\\varpi_{j\\ell}$, $\\bar{\\varpi}$"
  ),
  meaning = c(
    paste0(
      "Probability of misclassifying a draw of type $j$ into type ",
      "$\\ell$; pairwise overlap ",
      "$\\varpi_{j\\ell} = \\varpi_{\\ell \\mid j} + ",
      "\\varpi_{j \\mid \\ell}$; and its average over pairs."
    )
  ),
  group = "Overlap",
  fill = list(header = "#ddd8d0", data = "#f0ece6"),
  caption = "MixSim overlap between cell types."
)

```
